PROJECT 02 / Iowa State University · ongoing research

STM32H7 Photoacoustic Acquisition System

Designing an STM32H7 acquisition architecture for pulsed-LED photoacoustic tomography, with timer-triggered ADC sampling, DMA-to-memory buffering, and a planned ESP32 gateway.

STM32H7ADC · DMATimer-triggered acquisition

Research context

Developing a microcontroller-based acquisition platform for pulsed-LED photoacoustic tomography at Iowa State University, working with Prof. Manojit Pramanik.

My focus

Timer-triggered ADC sampling, DMA-to-RAM buffering, memory organization, and peripheral integration. The design work explores how timing and data movement constrain an embedded acquisition pipeline.

System direction

The development plan connects STM32H7 acquisition to a planned ESP32 gateway and host interface. MCU selection and end-to-end integration remain development decisions.

Current evidence

Ongoing research documented in my resume and development plan. No completed tomography reconstruction, measured throughput, or end-to-end hardware validation is claimed here.
